name: FireRed Tilesheet Importer Prototype
description: Experimental Red-only, tilesheet-first FireRed visual importer. It generates only evidence-approved native 8x8 target slots from a verified local FireRed source while preserving existing Gen 1 map grids, block definitions, and gameplay semantics.
